verdict.rationale: A live probe found an OpenAPI document at developer.monday.com/.well-known/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec can be downloaded. The core platform API is GraphQL, and the evidence does not show what this OpenAPI file covers. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec and its scope, evidence that it covers the main GraphQL platform API (or a downloadable GraphQL schema/introspection), independent corroboration.
